title: 野餐前的两张清单
audio_introduction: Listen to the whole conversation. Write p or b in each blank.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Anna, let us check our picnic lists before we go to the shop. I have a plate on my list. The first letter of plate is already written as an example.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Good idea, Milo. What food will you get?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I will buy some bread for lunch and some pears for the fruit basket.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: My list starts with popcorn. I will also buy some buns and some peppers.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Please leave room for my biscuits and peaches in the picnic bag.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Of course. I still need potatoes for the salad and berries for our fruit cups.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Now we both have five things. Let us take our lists to the shop.

instruction: 听一段完整对话，完成两个人各五行的清单。左列首行为已解示例，其余9处只填 p 或 b，不填完整单词。源遍数及读答时间未知；本机单遍、前后各20秒，可重播，属于审阅安排。
local_rate_notice: 本机对话按实测词速做保留音高的减速，约110英文词/分钟；不是原录音速度，也未完成儿童难度或自然听辨标定。
scope_notice: 香港KS1学段官方教学形式的原创参照；未绑定内地小学具体年级，不计入15档年级覆盖或当前内地非纸笔真题。两列、9响应、一个示例、p/b候选和整段对话保留；主题和措辞为原创。
